shots.purpose: Open on the paradox: one car profile split by the hinge — rigid intact nose on the cool side, crumpled nose on the warm side
shots.claim: pre-crumple-era rigid designs transmitted sharp deceleration spikes and cabin intrusion to occupants
shots.evidence: split-field plate: steel-blue intact car outline left, rust crumpled-nose outline right, cabin shaded on both
shots.motion_reason: slow push-in centred on the hinge so both states read at once

subject_contract.expected_subject: hinge-split car profile: intact cool side versus crumpled warm side

shots.purpose: Name the two halves: the glowing survival cage behind, the marked crush zone ahead of it
shots.claim: modern cars pair deformable crush zones with a high-strength passenger cell
shots.evidence: vehicle profile with an amber glowing cage grid over the cabin and a hatched crush zone over the front rail
shots.motion_reason: drift from cage to crush zone

subject_contract.expected_subject: car profile with glowing cabin cage and hatched front crush zone

shots.purpose: The reveal: the 1952 patent idea — straight rail flips to a bellows-folded rail on the hinge
shots.claim: Barényi patented the crumple-zone concept in 1952; Mercedes introduced it on the W111 in 1959
shots.evidence: patent-style front rail drawing: straight beam on the cool half, bellows-folded beam on the warm half, 1952 number
shots.motion_reason: the fold state animates as the flip, not a morph drift

subject_contract.expected_subject: straight versus bellows-folded rail across the hinge, patent plate style

shots.purpose: The one-line physics: same momentum change, two stop traces — tall spike versus long low curve
shots.claim: for the same change of momentum, spreading the stop over a longer time lowers the average force
shots.evidence: two deceleration traces over time: steel tall spike labelled rigid stop, amber long curve labelled crumpled stop, equal areas
shots.motion_reason: traces draw on left to right

subject_contract.expected_subject: two crash-pulse curves of equal area with different peaks

shots.purpose: Escalate into sequence: fold stages one-two-three light up down the rail while the cage stays bright
shots.claim: crumple zones convert kinetic energy into plastic deformation of engineered fold structures in a designed sequence
shots.evidence: vehicle profile with numbered fold zones glowing in sequence front to back, survival cell drawn bright and undeformed
shots.transition_reason: cut from pulse graph to sequence

subject_contract.expected_subject: three sequenced fold stages on the front rail with intact bright cage

shots.purpose: The staged timeline inside the pulse: fold, pretension tick, airbag bloom
shots.claim: restraints are staged inside the crash pulse: pretensioners first, airbag inflation within tens of milliseconds
shots.evidence: horizontal crash-pulse timeline with event markers: fold stages, belt tick, airbag ellipse blooming at its slot
shots.motion_reason: markers land in sequence along the timeline

subject_contract.expected_subject: crash-pulse timeline with sequenced restraint event markers

shots.purpose: Resolve: the dented car and the untouched occupant — the dent was the system working
shots.claim: the crush structure's extended pulse and energy absorption are what protect the occupant
shots.evidence: final hinge split: fully crumpled warm-side nose, bright undeformed cage with a calm occupant silhouette on the cool side

subject_contract.expected_subject: resolved hinge split: crumpled nose beside intact glowing cage with occupant
